title: 'You can laugh at solution': Sindhu reacts to monkey-proof Worlds preps

The Indira Gandhi Stadium has been upgraded with sealed vents, double doors, anti-pest gel and predator-call machines. According to TimesofIndia.com, four men trained to imitate langur calls have also been hired to deter monkeys. Sindhu called the efforts uniquely Indian and warmly welcoming.

title: For India, the Mecca pact is a setback. For China, it's a warning
description: A new defense pact between Pakistan, Saudi Arabia, and Turkey has been signed. This agreement is seen as a setback for India's regional interests. China may benefit commercially from increased weapon system access. However, the pact could also reduce US military focus in West Asia. This shift might allow greater US attention on China's growing influence.

title: Austin homeowner pays $3,000 to trim trees after insurance warning
description: Texas homeowners are increasingly finding that insurance companies are using aerial images of their properties to assess risks and decide whether to renew policies. Insurers use satellite, aircraft and third-party imagery, with some companies using AI to analyse roofs and identify possible damage. While insurers say the technology is faster and more efficient, consumer advocates warn that outdated or inaccurate images can lead to wrong decisions.

title: Mark Zuckerberg's $300m yacht booed over rescue call; clarification issued
description: In a surprising turn of events, Mark Zuckerberg's opulent yacht, Launchpad, faced backlash for not helping a stranded vessel within reach. Crew members clarified that they were on a different radio frequency and claimed assistance was imminent. A cruise ship later intervened, safely bringing the disabled boat back to Farragut Bay. Passengers on the cruise ship expressed their discontent by booing the yacht, which was positioned nearer to the emergency.

title: Jeff Bezos' ex-wife MacKenzie Scott returns to writing with 80K-word novel
description: Novelist MacKenzie Scott returns to fiction writing after a thirteen-year hiatus. She will serially release an eighty-thousand-word novel throughout the month of August. Scott studied creative writing under Nobel laureate Toni Morrison at Princeton University. She has given away over twenty-six billion dollars to numerous charitable organizations. Her recent donation of twenty million dollars supports mental health initiatives.

title: Google Drive ends Photos backups starting August 10: What users need to do
description: Starting August 10, 2026, the Google Drive desktop app will no longer support backups for Google Photos. Users are required to switch to the Google Photos app to continue folder backups smoothly. Thankfully, existing photos will remain intact and secure. However, to enable new automatic backups, users must adjust their settings, as this change affects only computer folder backups, leaving phone backups unaffected.

title: 97-year-old Betty Bromage breaks her own Guinness World Record as oldest wing walker
description: Betty Bromage, aged ninety-seven, has once again become the world's oldest female wing walker. She achieved this remarkable feat in Gloucestershire, United Kingdom on August fourth, 2026. This accomplishment came just a year after she suffered a stroke, proving age is no barrier. Bromage undertook the thrilling adventure to raise funds for the hospital that cared for her. Her actions highlight a growing trend of seniors embracing adventurous travel experiences.
